'''Discord Art Contest Winners''' ---- On the Tower Defense Simulator Discord, occasional art contests are held. These art contests usually have rules about what is allowed and what is not allowed. Those who win are usually rewarded with a prize, as well as having their artwork featured in the lobby. All contests and their winners can be seen below. The contest winner's name is their Discord username. This does not include developer picks or honorable mentions.
